source_text: Intactivist movements, originating in the 1970s with groups like the National Organization of Circumcision Information Resources Center (NOCIRC), frame circumcision as a form of genital mutilation analogous to female genital mutilation (FGM), emphasizing the irreversible removal of the foreskin, which contains specialized nerve endings.
